candidates.change_summary: Replace the burn function's onlyOwner modifier with no modifier, allowing any caller to burn their own tokens and reduce totalSupply when burn is called by non-owner.
Change burn to subtract from totalSupply twice (double-decrement) so totalSupply is reduced more than the owner's balance removal, altering observable totalSupply.
Change burn to subtract from totalSupply zero (no-op), so calling burn does not reduce totalSupply even though balanceOf is reduced.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), which can change whether burn (guarded by onlyOwner) can be executed and thus whether totalSupply changes.
Replace the owner-only restriction on burn by removing the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call burn and reduce their balance/totalSupply.
Change the balance deduction in burn to subtract from a fixed address (owner) instead of msg.sender, so burning affects owner's balance rather than caller's.
Change burn to decrease totalSupply but not adjust any account balances, so balances remain unchanged while totalSupply drops.
Modify owned() to set owner to msg.sender when called by current owner, enabling ownership transfer via this function and thus changing which account gets affected by owner-only burn.
